mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing the risk-free rate and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and potential economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based weakening in consumer and business demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month values, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), which signals contraction in manufacturing activity, S&P 500 returns underperform over the next 60 trading days as recession risks increase and corporate investment slows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230.0, it indicates elevated inflation pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals severe labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining housing starts (HOUST < 740.0), indicating a slowdown in the residential sector, S&P 500 returns underperform over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is below 740.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 96.0) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings growth is anticipated.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 96.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
